title: CRM & Offline Sales Report
description: Lead quality and real sales: funnel, cost per qualified lead and per won deal.

generation.instructions: Act as a senior performance-marketing analyst at a media agency reporting to an advertiser. This report covers CRM & Offline Sales. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (markets, platforms, campaign types, seasonality, budget, tracking) more than restating them, and end with a concrete recommendation where possible.

children.markdown: Lead quality and real sales: funnel, cost per qualified lead and per won deal.

More leads at lower quality is not progress - judge platforms on qualified leads and won deals.

**Ask:** which platforms bring leads that actually buy?
Where leads drop out and which platforms bring buyers.

Meta lead forms bring volume but lower qualification than search.

**Ask:** should bidding optimise on qualified leads?
Cost per qualified lead / won deal and performance per location.
**Cost per Lead & per Won Deal by Month**

Offline conversion import (SmartConversion) teaches bidding which leads buy.

Speed to first contact drives qualification.

**Ask:** which locations follow up too slowly?
